note: The style bank (2026-09-20). Nothing refuses an unknown style yet — the variation chain should read this list next.

rows.name: Claymation
rows.what: Everything is hand-sculpted modelling clay, shot frame by frame on a tabletop set.
rows.examples: A paid swipe: a claymation health explainer, 4 variants; two saved carousels on how claymation ads are made (2026-09-22)
rows.evidence: Named by the owner 2026-09-20 (agency Notion page + Instagram '21 ad formats' list); one paid swipe on file, two saves on how the ads are made.

extra.formula: stop-motion claymation: every surface hand-sculpted plasticine with visible thumbprints and tool marks, slightly lumpy proportions, matte clay skin, tiny handmade props, soft tabletop studio light, shallow depth of field of a miniature set
extra.motion: animated on twos, tiny jitter between frames, no motion blur

rows.note: defined by the machine, review pending

rows.name: Paper cut-out
rows.what: Layered cut paper and card, flat shapes with real paper shadows between the layers.

extra.formula: layered paper-craft: every shape cut from coloured card and construction paper, visible fibre texture and cut edges, stacked layers casting small real drop shadows, flat colour, no gradients, lit like a shadow box
extra.motion: pieces slide, hinge and pop like puppets on pins; stepped timing

rows.name: Crochet
rows.what: Everything is knitted or crocheted yarn — soft amigurumi people and props.

extra.formula: crochet amigurumi: every person and object made of chunky yarn stitches, visible loops and fuzz, safety-eye faces, stuffed rounded forms, felt details, warm soft window light, macro lens look
extra.motion: gentle wobble, stop-motion on twos, yarn squashes softly

rows.name: Needle felt
rows.what: Matted wool felt figures, fuzzier and more sculpted than crochet.

extra.formula: needle-felted wool: figures and props sculpted from matted wool roving, fuzzy halo of stray fibres on every edge, bead eyes, muted natural dyes, miniature handmade set, soft daylight
extra.motion: stop-motion on twos, fibres shimmer slightly frame to frame

rows.name: Felt puppet
rows.what: Hand-and-rod foam puppets with felt skin, big mouths and ping-pong eyes on a TV-studio set.

extra.formula: children's television puppet show: soft fleece-and-foam puppet characters with wide hinged mouths and round plastic eyes, visible fleece texture and stitched seams, bright 1980s television studio lighting, colourful simple set
extra.motion: puppeteered bobbing, mouth flaps on syllables, arms move on rods
extra.ip_flag: Named after a trademarked puppet franchise — keep the look generic, never the characters.

rows.name: Brick figure
rows.what: A world of snap-together plastic bricks with little cylinder-headed figures.

extra.formula: plastic brick toy world: every object built from glossy interlocking studded bricks, people as small cylinder-headed toy figures with printed faces and claw hands, injection-moulded plastic sheen, macro photography of a toy set, shallow depth of field
extra.motion: stiff stop-motion, figures hop and swivel at the waist, on twos
extra.ip_flag: Trademarked toy system — never show the logo or licensed figures.

rows.name: Miniature diorama
rows.what: A real place shrunk to a model-railway set, shot tilt-shift.

extra.formula: handmade miniature diorama: scale-model buildings, painted figurines, static grass and model trees, tilt-shift lens with a thin band of focus, bright hobby-lamp light, slight plastic sheen
extra.motion: slow overhead drift, figures move in tiny stop-motion steps

rows.name: Anime
rows.what: Japanese TV animation — clean ink lines, flat cel shading, big expressive eyes, painted backgrounds.

extra.formula: Japanese anime: clean black line art, two-tone cel shading, large expressive eyes, glossy hair highlights, detailed hand-painted background, soft bloom on light sources
extra.motion: held poses with snappy moves, speed lines, hair and cloth sway, animated on threes

rows.name: 1950s hand-drawn cel
rows.what: Mid-century feature animation — inked outlines, gouache backgrounds, storybook warmth.

extra.formula: 1950s hand-drawn cel animation: confident ink outlines, flat opaque paint fills, rounded appealing character design, soft gouache painted background, slight film grain and gate weave
extra.motion: on twos, squash and stretch, overlapping follow-through
extra.ip_flag: Keep it period-generic; never a studio's characters.

rows.name: Adult cartoon
rows.what: Flat wobbly-line TV cartoon with bug eyes and deadpan faces.

extra.formula: adult animated sitcom: thin uniform outlines, flat colours with no shading, simple rubbery bodies, large white eyes with scribbled pupils, slack mouths, plain flat backgrounds
extra.motion: limited animation, mouth-flap dialogue, sudden jerky gestures
extra.ip_flag: Named after a trademarked show — generic look only.

rows.name: Comic panel
rows.what: Printed comic book — heavy inks, halftone dots, panel borders and speech balloons.

extra.formula: printed comic book panel: bold black inks, Ben-Day halftone dot shading, limited four-colour palette, slightly misregistered print, white panel gutter around the frame
extra.motion: parallax between cut-out layers, panel-to-panel snaps, impact bursts

rows.name: Whiteboard sketch
rows.what: Black marker line drawings on a white board, drawn in as you watch.

extra.formula: whiteboard marker illustration: simple black dry-erase line drawings on a clean white board, one accent colour, hand-lettered labels, slight marker streaks, no shading
extra.motion: lines draw themselves on, a hand may enter to sketch; nothing else moves

rows.name: Storybook watercolour
rows.what: Soft children's-book illustration — wet washes, pencil lines, paper grain.

extra.formula: children's storybook watercolour: loose wet-on-wet washes, visible pencil under-drawing, cold-press paper grain, soft edges, gentle limited palette
extra.motion: subtle boil on the line, slow page-turn moves, drifting washes

rows.name: Family 3D animation
rows.what: Big-studio 3D feature look — appealing stylised people, huge eyes, soft subsurface skin, cinematic light.

extra.formula: big-studio 3D animated feature: stylised appealing character with large expressive eyes and simplified features, soft subsurface-scattered skin, groomed hair, richly detailed set, warm cinematic key light with rim light
extra.motion: full fluid character animation, anticipation and follow-through, slow push-ins
extra.ip_flag: Studio names are trademarks — generic look only, never their characters.

rows.name: 3D cutaway explainer
rows.what: Glossy 3D simulation that flies inside a body or object to show what is happening.

extra.formula: 3D science-explainer animation render: smooth simplified mannequin-like figure with matte neutral-grey surface, clean dark studio void background, soft even light, one glowing highlighted region with a floating magnified inset showing a simple stylised diagram of skin layers, saturated colour only on the part being explained
extra.motion: continuous camera fly-in from outside to inside, parts animate mechanically, labels pop on
extra.ip_flag: Named after a creator — the look is generic 3D explainer.

rows.name: Skeleton character
rows.what: A friendly glossy 3D skeleton living a normal life — the narrator of body stories.

extra.formula: stylised 3D skeleton character: clean ivory bones with soft gloss, big round eye sockets with expressive pupils, wearing everyday clothes, everyday real-world setting, soft cinematic light, shallow depth of field
extra.motion: full character animation, exaggerated jaw on speech, bones clack subtly

rows.name: Low poly
rows.what: Faceted 3D made of flat triangles, like an early game console or a papercraft model.

extra.formula: low-poly 3D: every form built from large flat-shaded triangles, no textures, simple gradient sky, pastel palette, hard facet edges, soft ambient occlusion
extra.motion: smooth floaty camera orbit, simple bobbing loops

rows.name: 16-bit pixel art
rows.what: Chunky retro-game pixels, side-on, limited palette.

extra.formula: 16-bit pixel art: chunky visible pixels, limited 32-colour palette, dithered shading, side-on game-screen composition, crisp nearest-neighbour edges
extra.motion: few-frame sprite loops, screen scrolls sideways, text types on

rows.name: Hypermotion cinematic
rows.what: Car-commercial energy — impossible fast camera moves, macro details, speed ramps, hard light.

extra.formula: high-end commercial cinematography: anamorphic lens, hard rim light and deep contrast, macro detail, atmospheric haze, rich saturated grade, razor-sharp product surfaces
extra.motion: fast FPV-style fly-throughs, whip pans, speed ramps into slow motion, match cuts

rows.name: Phone-camera UGC
rows.what: Looks like a real person filmed it on their phone. The baseline everything else departs from.

extra.formula: native phone-camera footage: handheld front camera, available room light, true unretouched skin texture, slight noise and compression, nothing styled
extra.motion: handheld micro-shake, natural pauses, no cuts inside a line

rows.name: Horror
rows.what: Dread lighting — underlit faces, green-black shadows, grain, something wrong in the background.

extra.formula: horror film still: low-key underlighting, sickly green-teal shadows, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, fog, wide-angle lens slightly too close, unsettling stillness
extra.motion: slow creeping push-in, flicker, sudden jump cut

rows.name: VHS camcorder
rows.what: 1990s home video — soft, smeary colour, tracking lines, date stamp.

extra.formula: 1990s VHS camcorder footage: soft low-resolution image, colour bleed, tracking-line noise, blown highlights, orange date stamp in the corner, 4:3 feel inside the frame
extra.motion: handheld zooms, auto-focus hunting, tape glitches on cuts

rows.name: Fight-night broadcast
rows.what: Pay-per-view sports graphics — tale of the tape, metallic lower-thirds, arena light.

extra.formula: combat-sports broadcast: dark arena with hard spotlights and haze, metallic chrome-and-red broadcast graphics, versus split, stat bars, dramatic rim light on the subject
extra.motion: graphic slams and wipes, slow-motion walkouts, crowd flashes
extra.ip_flag: League names and logos are trademarks — generic broadcast look only.

rows.name: Glass ASMR
rows.what: Everyday things made of clear coloured glass or jelly, sliced or squeezed in macro.

extra.formula: translucent glass-object macro: the subject made of clear coloured glass with internal refraction and caustics, on a clean cutting board, softbox highlights, extreme macro
extra.motion: one slow satisfying action — a slice, a crack, a squeeze — in a single take

rows.name: Macro beauty commercial
rows.what: Extreme close-ups on skin, liquid and glass — razor-sharp texture, everything else falling away.

extra.formula: high-end macro beauty commercial: extreme close-up detail, razor-sharp surface texture, very shallow depth of field, soft wrapped studio light with a specular kicker, clean luminous grade
extra.motion: slow macro slides and rack-focus pulls, liquid in slow motion

rows.name: Studio product hero
rows.what: Clean studio photography in motion: seamless backdrop, controlled light, the subject as the only thing in the world.

extra.formula: studio product-hero photography: seamless single-colour cyclorama backdrop, controlled softbox key with gentle gradient falloff, crisp edges, no set, catalogue-clean grade
extra.motion: slow turntable rotation, gentle push-in, light sweeps across the surface

rows.name: Dark luxury
rows.what: Black marble, cool clinical light, deep blacks — the prestige skincare look.

extra.formula: dark luxury editorial commercial: black marble and slate surfaces, cool clinical top light, deep saturated blacks, fine metallic and glass highlights, restrained desaturated palette
extra.motion: slow deliberate dolly moves, light glints travelling across edges

rows.name: 16mm archival film
rows.what: Looks like found documentary footage — grain, gate weave, light leaks, soft old lenses.

extra.formula: vintage 16mm archival documentary film: heavy organic grain, gate weave, light leaks at the frame edge, soft vintage lens, faded warm colour, slight vignette
extra.motion: handheld observational camera, film flicker, occasional splice jump

rows.name: Neon noir
rows.what: Wet night streets, warm bulbs against cold neon, glass and chrome.

extra.formula: neon-noir night cinematography: wet reflective surfaces, cold cyan and magenta neon against warm practical bulbs, deep shadow, atmospheric haze, anamorphic flares
extra.motion: slow gliding camera, reflections rippling, signs flickering

rows.name: Fashion editorial
rows.what: Magazine-campaign glamour — glossy skin, big light, oversized type energy.

extra.formula: luxury fashion magazine editorial campaign: glossy retouched skin, bold hard beauty light, saturated colour-blocked backdrop, confident high-fashion styling, Y2K gloss
extra.motion: snappy cuts, poses that hit on the beat, fast zoom punches
extra.ip_flag: Magazine names are trademarks — generic look only.

rows.name: Oil painting in motion
rows.what: Thick visible brushstrokes that swirl as the scene moves.

extra.formula: post-impressionist oil painting: thick impasto brushstrokes, visible palette-knife texture, swirling directional strokes, saturated complementary colours, canvas weave showing through
extra.motion: brushstrokes flow and re-form every frame, slow drifting camera

rows.name: Ink wash
rows.what: Black ink and water on rice paper — soft bleeds, empty space, a few decisive strokes.

extra.formula: East Asian ink-wash painting: black sumi ink bleeding into wet rice paper, soft tonal washes, large areas of empty paper, a few decisive dry-brush strokes, one muted accent colour
extra.motion: ink blooms and spreads, forms dissolve into and out of washes
